# pve_replication_schedule_now (Action)

Schedule a replication job to run as soon as possible.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_replication_schedule_now" "example" {
  config {
    item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
    node    = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_replication_schedule_now.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) Replication Job ID. The ID is composed of a Guest ID and a job number, separated by a hyphen, i.e. '<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>'.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
